brief.note: Records again on Friday; these three fell on Thursday's earnings. Prices are each name's post-drop close.

candidates.name: Fluence Energy
candidates.business: Builds grid-scale battery storage systems for utilities
candidates.cause: Revenue missed by $151m and full-year guidance was cut to $2.9-3.1bn from $3.2-3.6bn after factory setbacks, with a surprise loss.
candidates.right: The factory problems have to be fixed while the data-centre backlog is still there
candidates.wrong: It is loss-making, so there are no earnings to value it on if guidance keeps falling

candidates.name: Celsius Holdings
candidates.business: Sells Celsius and Alani Nu energy drinks
candidates.cause: Revenue rose 10.6% to $818m but missed by $52m, and the flagship Celsius brand shrank 11.7% as slow lines were cut.
candidates.right: The cull of slow-selling lines has to explain the brand's fall, not lost demand
candidates.wrong: Energy-drink shelf space is a war, and Celsius is losing it to newer brands

candidates.name: Peloton Interactive
candidates.business: Sells exercise bikes and subscriptions to fitness classes
candidates.cause: Turned its first annual profit, then guided fiscal 2027 sales down about 4% as connected-fitness subscriptions fell 8.8%.
candidates.right: Subscriber losses have to stop, because the subscription is the whole profitable part
candidates.wrong: 33x forward earnings for a business whose customer base shrinks every quarter
